title: 2025 AMC 10A Problem 9
statement: Let \(f(x) = 100x^3 - 300x^2 + 200x.\) For how many real numbers \(a\) does the graph of \(y = f(x - a)\) pass through the point \((1, 25)?\)

solutions.text: The graph passes through \((1,25)\) exactly when \(f(1 - a) = 25.\) Let \(t = 1 - a,\) so we count solutions of \(f(t) = 25.\) Factor \(f(x) = 100x(x-1)(x-2),\) with roots \(0, 1, 2.\) On \((0,1),\) the function is positive and \(f(0.5) = 37.5 \gt 25,\) so continuity gives one root on each side of \(0.5.\) On \((1,2)\) the function is negative, while for \(x \gt 2\) it increases from \(0\) to infinity, giving one more root. A cubic equation has at most \(3\) real roots, so these are all the solutions. Each gives one \(a,\) so there are \(3\) values. Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: The graph of \(y = f(x-a)\) passes through \((1,25)\) exactly when \(f(1 - a) = 25\)
Factor \(f(x) = 100x(x-1)(x-2)\) and count solutions of \(f(t) = 25\); note that \(f(0.5)\) exceeds \(25\)
